surface: A confirm dialog the application opens while the user is in the grid: its name and description, the focus inside it, Escape, and the focus it gives back.

steps.note: The application opens the confirm dialog (closable, so Escape closes it) while the grid has the focus. The dialog takes the focus to its first button: a reader says the dialog's name, `Confirm`, its description, the button and the dialog role (`dialog`, VoiceOver `alert dialog`). The page's own dialog, shown on load before the user touched the grid, does not take the focus, by design. The scenario starts on the page (`start: page`): the page's first item is the `Input` field. VoiceOver with WebKit said nothing on this first step in some runs, and read the same dialog when it opened again.
A modal dialog keeps Tab inside it, back to its first button. Finding: Tab walks out of the dialog to the `Input 2` field behind it (known: `dialogs-leak-tab` in the findings ledger).
Escape closes the dialog and gives the focus back to the cell the user was on, `Country 1`.
The grid has the keyboard again.
The application opens the dialog again: its name, the button and the dialog role.
OK closes the dialog, and the focus goes back to the cell, `Country 2`.
